parts.gloss: he who does not enjoy or share

words.gloss: he who does not enjoy or share

literal: One who has no love, one who has no abundant allies, and who himself does not enjoy or share, how will he ward off the enemy's strength?
translation: How can a man who has no love in his heart, no powerful allies to support him, and who does not himself enjoy or share his resources, ever withstand the strength of his enemy?
modern: அன்பு இல்லாதவனாகவும், சிறந்த துணை இல்லாதவனாகவும், தானும் அனுபவிக்காதவனாகவும் இருப்பவன், தன் பகைவனுடைய வலிமையை எவ்வாறு வெல்ல முடியும்?
explanation: This couplet describes the vulnerability of an isolated and miserly person against an adversary. A person who lacks love cannot win the hearts of others, and without noble allies, he stands alone. Furthermore, if he is selfish and does not enjoy or share his resources, he remains weak and friendless. The poet asks rhetorically how such a person can ever ward off the strength of an enemy.
